scene: You zip down to the bustling grand terminal below the breezy fields.
picture: A wide side-view of a grand transit station on a level cobblestone line. On the left waits a frosty sleigh tram marked Snow Globe Works. The boy in his orange vest and scarf stands between terminals. In the centre moors a glass-bottomed boat, and on the right swings a hillside chairlift heading up.
shown: a frosty red sleigh tram on rails idling at a snowy terminal platform on the left
a glass-bottomed blue canal boat moored at the wooden dock platform right in the centre
a swinging metal hillside chairlift bench hanging over a steep incline on the far right
